title: adc~

flags.name: -m <list>
flags.description: creates a multichannel signal with number of input channels and starting channel (default 2 1)

methods.description: resets the input channels, or the multichannel setting with the -m flag

body: [adc~] and [dac~] provide real-time audio input and output for Pd, respectively, whether analog or digital. By default they are stereo, with channels 1 and 2. Arguments set other channel numbers, and the -m flag makes a single multichannel signal instead.
